included.name: Scholarly identity
included.text: Sign in with ORCID, Zenodo or your institution's own login. Publications, affiliations and research interests arrive from ORCID and OpenAlex rather than being retyped.

included.name: Citable discussions
included.text: Posts and discussions can take DOIs and become citable FAIR objects, preserved as part of the scholarly record instead of lost in a private thread.

included.name: Local control, global reach
included.text: Each community runs its own server. Your data stays under your control, and you connect globally without giving up local governance.

included.name: Metadata, automatically
included.text: Share a paper and watch it come alive: metadata, co-authors, datasets and related works. Colleagues join in from whatever platform they already use.

included.name: Modular by design
included.text: Add repository connectors, peer review workflows or research tools as your community finds it needs them.
